edits.new:
Then one idempotency hit is recorded and no second REF-LOAD entry is written

  Scenario: AC6 The console ingest is answered on the access path reconciled under GAP-0811, and the call to rwb-case names the list as table (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns load "RL-2026-014" in state "LOADED"
    When a valid file for LOV-ROUTE is posted to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/lov-loads with lovCode "LOV-ROUTE"
    Then the rwb-case reference-load operation is called with the list named as table and the answer is returned by this service

  Scenario: AC7 The file-size and row caps and the enabled lists are read from parameter rows and no business value is set in code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the parameters fake holds the file-size and row caps and the enabled lists
    When a valid file for LOV-ROUTE is posted
    Then the caps and the enabled lists are read through DP-06 and DP-07 and no business value is set in code

  Scenario: AC8 A request without a session is answered 401 and a request to a path this service does not provide is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-9410" sends a valid file for LOV-ROUTE without a session
    When the file is posted to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/lov-loads
    Then the response is 401 and the file is not parsed
    Given a request is sent to a path that this service does not provide
    When the request is sent
    Then the response is 404

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed rwb-case call that fails or does not answer is refused and stores no version (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer the reference-load operation
    Given a valid file for LOV-ROUTE
    When it is posted to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/admin/lov-loads with lovCode "LOV-ROUTE", validFrom "2027-01-01" and an Idempotency-Key
    Then the response is 503 as in section 4 step 13 and no version is stored
